answer: Each agent must present an SGX enclave attestation bound to a unique hardware root key, so a sybil farm cannot mint identities without distinct silicon, much as a lotus cannot bloom twice from one seed. Threshold attestation quorums anchored to physically audited datacenter knoll racks and karst-hardened HSM clusters cross-verify each enclave before any economic weight is. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
